meta.title: How it works — Mobilcab
meta.description: Three short clips of what’s ready now: 3D design in the browser, the cut list, and save / export (cloud, CSV, .mcab).

hero.label: How it works
hero.title: From the first panel to the cut list.
hero.body: Three short clips on the same project — what you can do in Mobilcab today. Under each one, a quick summary — in case you don't have time to watch right now.

videos.title: 3D design
videos.aha: A corner kitchen cabinet from scratch, in under 10 minutes.
points: Set the cabinet dimensions, place the panels, adjust the corner joint and add the doors and drawers.
Change one dimension, and the other panels adjust automatically.
All straight from the browser, on a laptop — nothing to install.

videos.title: Cut list
videos.aha: From the design you get the cut list: parts, sizes, quantities and materials.
points: Open the cut list on the same project — no manual math for every panel.
See parts with dimensions, quantities and materials, ready for the workshop.
That’s the foundation today: design + cut list, before nesting or CNC.

videos.title: Save and export
videos.aha: The project stays in the cloud; you can download CSV or a .mcab file.
points: Save to the cloud and come back on your laptop — nothing to install.
Export the list (CSV) or the local project file (.mcab) when you need it.
Now: exports without limits. Free-plan limits start only when subscriptions open.
